newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sets repo operation at fixed 4.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sets repo operation at fixed 4.60 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set a one-week reverse repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed 4.60 percent.
The operation will run from November 20 to November 27 with all bids to be received by 0900 GMT on November 19.
This was the fourth repo operation to be set at 4.60 percent as advised by the Riksbank a few weeks ago.
The central bank changed its policy of lowering the repo rate every other week and set the key interest rate for a few weeks more akin to the Bundesbank policy.
The repo rate, the central rate of a three tier system that is used to control money market liquidity, began the year at 8.91 percent.
The Riksbank's deposit and lending rates, which mark the floor and ceiling of its interest rate corridor, currently stand at 4.25 percent and 5.75 percent respectively.
